# Package Documentation Template

## Purpose

Briefly describe what this app or package owns.

## Local Structure

- Main folders and what they contain
- Key entry points
- Main aggregates, use cases, services, or actions

## Exposed Surface

- Public DTOs, types, services, actions, or entry points exposed to other packages or apps

## Relationships

- Upstream dependencies on other packages or infrastructure
- Downstream consumers such as apps, domains, or external systems
- Important cross-domain interactions

## Architecture Notes

- Boundary decisions
- Important invariants
- What must stay aligned with LikeC4
